CI triage for Gerrit 2957 PS1 (69260ff0ee704e798533babe9d1418ccb2c8c527): CI run 34439576412 failed after 20,254 passing tests on tests/scripts/test_feature_branch_inventory.py::test_rebased_content_equivalent_branch_reports_merged. The exact patch-set checkout passes the focused test and changes only five unrelated comment/docstring files. Root cause is a pre-existing test-double race: fake `git credential` returns without consuming stdin, while the production script uses `printf ... | git credential fill` under pipefail; a fixed 10,000-run reproduction produced 5 writer-side SIGPIPE failures. Created discovered bug robotlike-illdefined-motmot (c65c-931c-ee39-4e63) for the behavioral harness fix, outside this comments-only epic. Per flaky-test policy, no recheck, amend, submit, or source edit was performed.
